statement: The $`L\log L`$ Fourier-convergence conjecture. Proves that the ordinary symmetric Fourier partial sums of every complex-valued function in $`L\log L(\mathbb T)`$ converge almost everywhere along the full sequence. This resolves the classical sufficiency conjecture at the $`L\log L`$ scale.
